style_summary.description: 16mm Ektachrome stock. Heavy grain. Lens flare on direct sun. Warm color bleed at frame edges. Blacks are charcoal, never true black. Whites are bone, never pure white. The desert palette shifts with the sun angle across four scenes: late afternoon amber, pre-dusk bronze, sunset rose, post-sunset blue dusk. Every wide shot makes the man and machine look insignificant against the landscape. Every close shot makes the man and machine feel like the only things that exist.
style_summary.lens_characteristics: Lens flare on direct sun. Warm color bleed at frame edges. Period-appropriate 1960s anamorphic look.

palette.name: amber
palette.usage: Scene 1 dominant. Late afternoon desert light.

palette.name: rose
palette.usage: Scene 3 dominant. Sun on western ridge.

palette.name: charcoal
palette.usage: Shadow tone throughout. Never true black.

palette.name: bone
palette.usage: Highlight tone throughout. Never pure white.

scene_progression.description: Full amber. High saturation. Late afternoon at its warmest.
Amber cooling to bronze. Shadows lengthening. Warmth starting to drain.
Bronze to rose. Purple shadows. Sun on the western ridge. Transitional.
Last horizontal gold, side-lit, maximum contrast. Then rapid fade to cool blue dusk.

lighting.philosophy: The sun is the only light source. No fill. No bounce. The color arc tells time without a clock. The audience should feel the sun setting across the four scenes.

scene_lighting.sun_position: Low in the west, approximately 15-20 degrees above horizon
scene_lighting.key_light_direction: From the west (screen left in wide shots)
scene_lighting.shadow_quality: Long shadows stretching east. Warm. Defined edges.
scene_lighting.description: Late afternoon amber. Dust in the air catches the light and turns it gold. Heat shimmer on the horizon.

scene_lighting.sun_position: Dropping fast, approximately 8-12 degrees above horizon
scene_lighting.key_light_direction: From the west, lower angle than Scene 1
scene_lighting.shadow_quality: Longer shadows. Purple edges appearing. Warmth leaving.
scene_lighting.description: Pre-dusk. The light is beautiful and it is running out.

scene_lighting.sun_position: Touching the western ridge, approximately 2-5 degrees
scene_lighting.shadow_quality: Purple shadows. Long and dramatic. Cool tones creeping in.
scene_lighting.description: Fifteen minutes of usable light remain. The palette is shifting from warm to cool.

scene_lighting.sun_position: Half below western ridge, then gone
scene_lighting.key_light_direction: Horizontal side light, then ambient only
scene_lighting.shadow_quality: Maximum contrast side-lit faces, then flat blue ambient after sunset.
scene_lighting.description: The most cinematic light of the day — use every second of it. Then rapid transition to cool blue dusk.

Wardrobe: White cotton shirt (sweat-stained at collar and under arms), brown leather vest (sun-bleached), riding goggles pushed up on forehead. Front face, direct eye contact with camera. Color bleed at frame edges. Period: 1967. No modern elements. No helmet, no sunglasses, no clean or new clothing.

Same geological character — flat hardpan transitioning to rocky wash. The only thing that changes is the light. Cardon cacti (not saguaro) throughout. Canyon mouth appears in Scenes 3-4.

composition_rules.wide_shots: Every wide shot makes the man and machine look insignificant against the landscape. The desert is in charge. The motorcycle should be a speck in the earliest wide shots.
composition_rules.close_shots: Every close shot makes the man and machine feel like the only things that exist. Texture is everything — leather, rubber, metal, dust, skin.
composition_rules.detail_shots: Mechanically accurate. The audience believes the world or doesn't based on these shots. Hands on engine components, boot on kick lever, watch on wrist — all must be specific and correct.
composition_rules.general_philosophy: The landscape dwarfs the human in wide shots. The human fills the frame in close shots. There is no middle ground emotionally — either the desert is the subject or the man is.
